INTRODUCTION

Begin with something you can point to at a kitchen in Kisumu. On “Exam-Style Thinking — Approximations and Errors”, how would you explain approximations and errors to a classmate in one minute? • Units matter: write cm, m, Ksh, or items so the answer matches the question.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked situation at a home in Nakuru:
A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 10 each. Find the total.
